race.comment: SLIPSAIN (7) has continued to race his way into form this prep and looks ready to strike after another solid effort when finishing third over 1600m here last start. He slides down in class, and only needs some luck from a wide gate to be hard to hold out. LOVE REBEL (10) broke through in impressive fashion over this course last start when scoring by nearly 2 lengths. The extra 200m won't be an issue, and she can have the last say again. ICONIFY (3) showed plenty of determination when scoring her maiden win here 2 starts ago and then did not have much luck at the Sunshine Coast 10 days ago. He drops in weight and is worth another chance. DUST CLOUD (1) has been racing honestly, going down by the barest margin here 2 weeks ago when trying to make all the running, and he should be the one to peg back again with another 200m to travel here. DEVINE SQUIRE (6) has been racing well in a couple of starts since winning by a nose at Murwillumbah in June, and he has top 4 claims again.
